001package org.clafer.compiler;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import org.clafer.instance.InstanceModel;
006
007/**
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public interface InstanceIterator {
012
013    /**
014     * Find the next instance.
015     *
016     * @return {@code true} if and only if another solution is found,
017     * {@code false} otherwise
018     * @throws ReachedLimitException if resource limit reached
019     */
020    public boolean find();
021
022    /**
023     * Return the instance from the last {@link #find()} operation, if
024     * successful.
025     *
026     * @return the instance
027     */
028    public InstanceModel instance();
029
030    /**
031     * Return all the remaining instances.
032     *
033     * @return all the remaining instances
034     * @throws ReachedLimitException if resource limit reached
035     */
036    public default InstanceModel[] allInstances() throws ReachedLimitException {
037        List<InstanceModel> instances = new ArrayList<>();
038        while (find()) {
039            instances.add(instance());
040        }
041        return instances.toArray(new InstanceModel[instances.size()]);
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * Return the number of instances found so far.
046     *
047     * @return the number of instances found so far
048     */
049    public int instanceCount();
050}
